point.label: Helmstaedter mouse retina
point.exportAnnotation: Helmstaedter · retina imaged bounds · 2013 online publication · ≈1,203,840 µm³
point.sourceTitle: Helmstaedter et al. · Connectomic reconstruction of the inner plexiform layer
point.quote: this corresponds to a physical size of about 132 µm × 114 µm for each slice and a total thickness of 80 µm.
point.note: Inner retinal imaged stack (Mus musculus). Serial block-face electron microscopy. Approximate physical imaged bounds: 132 × 114 × 80 µm = 1,203,840 µm³ (0.00120384 mm³). The dimensions describe unexpanded, processed EM tissue. The volume retains processed-tissue dimensions; living-tissue shrinkage correction is unspecified. EM Datasets row 28.

point.label: MaleCNS
point.exportAnnotation: MaleCNS · adult male fly CNS · 2025 preprint v2 · 166,691 neurons
point.quote: In total, we identified, proofread and annotated 166,691 neurons (including sensory axons) across the entire volume
point.note: Adult male brain and nerve cord (Drosophila melanogaster). Enhanced focused ion beam scanning electron microscopy (FIB-SEM). Proofread and annotated neurons across the central nervous system, including sensory axons. EM Datasets row 115.

point.label: Eyewire II
point.exportAnnotation: Eyewire II · partial mouse retina · 2026 preprint v1 · >25,000 neurons
point.sourceTitle: Stroeh et al. · Eyewire II (bioRxiv v1)
point.quote: Human proofreading of an automated reconstruction has so far yielded more than 8, 000 bipolar cells, 13, 000 amacrine cells, and 4, 000 retinal ganglion cells.
point.note: Adult mouse retina (Mus musculus). Electron microscopy (EM). Partial retinal map. Lower bound from the sum of three cell classes after human proofreading: 8,000 bipolar + 13,000 amacrine + 4,000 retinal ganglion cells. Automated detection is complete for synaptic ribbons; conventional synapse detection is in progress. EM Datasets row 124.

point.label: White C. elegans
point.exportAnnotation: White · canonical worm composite · 1986 print publication · 302 neurons
point.sourceTitle: White et al. · The structure of the nervous system of C. elegans
point.quote: The hermaphrodite nervous system has a total complement of 302 neurons, which are arranged in an essentially invariant structure.
point.note: Canonical hermaphrodite nervous system (Caenorhabditis elegans). Serial-section electron microscopy with manual reconstruction. Canonical complement in a composite of overlapping specimen series; pharyngeal connectivity was reported previously. EM Datasets row 9.

point.label: Helmstaedter mouse retina
point.exportAnnotation: Helmstaedter · partial retina · 2013 online publication · 950 neurons
point.sourceTitle: Helmstaedter et al. · Connectomic reconstruction of the inner plexiform layer
point.quote: Here we present for the mouse inner plexiform layer—the main computational neuropil region in the mammalian retina—the dense reconstruction of 950 neurons and their mutual contacts.
point.note: Inner plexiform layer, partial mouse retina (Mus musculus). Serial block-face electron microscopy with manual skeleton tracing and machine-learning segmentation. The neuronal cohort includes 840 classified neurons and 110 orphan reconstructions. The 173 glial cells are counted separately. Ganglion-cell dendrites and many amacrine dendrites are boundary-truncated. EM Datasets row 28.

point.label: Ryan Ciona larva
point.exportAnnotation: Ryan · larval Ciona CNS · 2016 online publication · 177 neurons
point.sourceTitle: Ryan et al. · The CNS connectome of a Ciona tadpole larva
point.quote: Using serial-section EM we document the synaptic connectome of the larva’s 177 CNS neurons.
point.note: Larval central nervous system (CNS), otolith through caudal nerve cord (Ciona intestinalis). Serial-section transmission electron microscopy with manual tracing. Neurons with axons and presynaptic sites among 301 imaged CNS cells in one larva, two hours after hatching. The series omits rostral and caudal cells. EM Datasets row 39.
